requirements.title: OPERATOR generic specifications require suitable function specifics
requirements.definition: An OPERATOR generic specification names only functions usable as defined operations; arity is one or two, dummy arguments are nonoptional dummy data objects with INTENT(IN) or VALUE, the result is not assumed character length, and intrinsic-operator extensions have arity consistent with intrinsic use while differing from intrinsic operations by type, kind, or rank, with CLASS(*) not counted as type/kind difference.

pending.operator-specifics-functions: PENDING positive source plan: INTERFACE OPERATOR(.twice.) contains a unary function twice_box with TYPE(box), INTENT(IN) dummy and INTEGER result; .twice. box(6) returns exact 12 from result sentinel -12.
pending.operator-arity-one-or-two: PENDING source-control plan includes unary .twice. and binary OPERATOR(+) functions, both exact; separate zero-argument and three-argument negatives mutate only the argument count and carry no diagnostic claim here.
pending.operator-dummies-nonoptional-data: PENDING source-control plan mutates the unary function dummy from a data object to a dummy procedure and separately adds OPTIONAL; conforming controls keep the TYPE(box), INTENT(IN) data dummy and exact result 12.
pending.operator-dummies-intent-in-or-value: PENDING source-control plan contrasts INTENT(IN) and VALUE conforming dummies with an INTENT(OUT) mutation; exact operation results use component sentinel -31 before assignment.
pending.operator-result-not-assumed-length: PENDING source-control plan for a character defined operator uses CHARACTER(len=3) result with exact 'abc'; the negative changes only the result to assumed length and claims no diagnostic here.
pending.intrinsic-operator-arity-consistent: PENDING source-control plan for OPERATOR(+) uses one unary and one binary function matching intrinsic arities; a three-argument mutation changes only arity and is not credited as a numbered diagnostic.
pending.intrinsic-operator-differs-from-intrinsi: PENDING positive plan for OPERATOR(+) uses TYPE(box) operands so integer intrinsic addition remains separate; exact box(2)+box(5) result has component 207, while integer 2+5 remains exact 7 under intrinsic operation ownership.

requirements.title: Defined operation notation follows unary prefix and binary infix function references
requirements.definition: A defined operation is treated as a function reference: unary notation passes the operand as the dummy argument, binary infix notation passes the left operand to the first dummy and the right operand to the second, and actual-argument restrictions for the function apply to the operands.

pending.unary-prefix-operand-correspondence: PENDING executable plan: defined operator .negbox. maps one TYPE(box) operand with component 8 to function result component -8; result starts at sentinel 999 and a direct function-call control verifies the same operand correspondence.
pending.binary-infix-left-right-correspondence: PENDING executable plan: OPERATOR(+) for TYPE(box) returns 100*left%value + right%value; box(2)+box(7) yields exact 207, while swapped operands yield 702, proving left-to-first and right-to-second mapping.
pending.defined-operation-invokes-function: PENDING executable plan increments no global state; it observes only the exact function result component 207 and mutates the expression to a direct function call and to an intrinsic integer addition control.
pending.operand-actual-argument-restrictions: PENDING source-control plan uses a function whose dummy has a visible INTENT(IN) data-object requirement, then mutates an operand context that would be invalid as the corresponding actual; diagnostic ownership stays with the actual-argument rule reached by that context.

requirements.title: Defined operators are generic and intrinsic relational spellings are paired
requirements.definition: A defined operator can apply to more than one function as a generic; intrinsic operator symbols include the intrinsic operations they represent; extending either spelling of a relational operator defines both spellings.

pending.defined-operator-generic-multiple-functi: PENDING executable plan: OPERATOR(.mix.) has integer-box and real-box specifics returning exact components 31 and 32 from sentinels -31 and -32, proving generic selection among multiple functions.
pending.intrinsic-operator-retains-intrinsic-ope: PENDING executable plan in the same scope defines OPERATOR(+) for TYPE(box) and evaluates both box(2)+box(5)==207 and integer 2+5==7, proving the intrinsic operation remains part of the generic properties for intrinsic symbols.
pending.relational-symbol-and-dot-form-both-defi: PENDING executable plan defines OPERATOR(<=) for TYPE(box) to return left%value <= right%value by a deliberately inverted component mapping; evaluate both a <= b and a .LE. b for a=2,b=5 as .true. and b <= a and b .LE. a as .false., with logical sentinels initialized to the opposite values.
